tools.name: query_logs
tools.description: Run a CloudWatch Logs Insights query on log groups over a time range, for example fields @timestamp, @message | filter @message like /ERROR/ | sort @timestamp desc | limit 50. Returns the fields and rows, at most 500 rows, and a link to the query in the CloudWatch console.

account.description: The 12-digit AWS account ID. It may be left out when Sidekick reads only one account.

limit.description: The most items to return, 1 to 500. Default 100.

logGroups.description: Log group names, or the start of names followed by *, for example ["/ecs/checkout", "/aws/eks/prod/*"]. One query reads at most 50 log groups.

query.description: The Logs Insights query, passed to CloudWatch as given. Use limit or stats to keep the result small.

region.description: The AWS Region, for example us-east-1. It may be left out when Sidekick reads only one Region.

since.description: The start of the range, in RFC 3339 form, for example 2026-05-04T10:00:00Z.

until.description: The end of the range, in RFC 3339 form, for example 2026-05-04T10:00:00Z.

tools.name: query_metrics
tools.description: Read CloudWatch metrics over a time range with GetMetricData: metrics by namespace, name, dimensions and statistic, and metric math expressions over them, such as 100 * errors / requests. Returns each series' points, oldest first.

account.description: The 12-digit AWS account ID. It may be left out when Sidekick reads only one account.

limit.description: The most items to return, 1 to 50. Default 10.

period.description: The seconds each point covers, a multiple of 60. Default and least: the smallest that gives at most 120 points per series.

dimensions.description: The metric's dimensions by name, for example {"LoadBalancer": "app/shop/50dc6c495c0c9188"}.

expression.description: A metric math expression over the IDs of other queries, for example 100 * m1 / m2, instead of namespace and metric.

hidden.description: Leave the query's own series out, for one only used in an expression.

id.description: The query's ID, starting with a lower-case letter, for example m1. Expressions name other queries by it.

metric.description: The metric's name, for example HTTPCode_Target_5XX_Count.

namespace.description: The metric's namespace, for example AWS/ApplicationELB.

stat.description: The metric's statistic: Average, Sum, Minimum, Maximum, SampleCount or a percentile such as p99. Default Average.

queries.description: The metrics and expressions to read. Each has an id and either namespace and metric, or expression.

region.description: The AWS Region, for example us-east-1. It may be left out when Sidekick reads only one Region.

since.description: The start of the range, in RFC 3339 form, for example 2026-05-04T10:00:00Z. Default: one hour before until.

until.description: The end of the range, in RFC 3339 form, for example 2026-05-04T10:00:00Z. Default: now.

tools.name: list_alarms
tools.description: List the CloudWatch alarms in a state, by default ALARM, with their reason, metric and threshold. With alarm, return that alarm and its state changes in a time range, newest first.

account.description: The 12-digit AWS account ID. It may be left out when Sidekick reads only one account.

alarm.description: The name of one alarm, to read its state history.

limit.description: The most items to return, 1 to 100. Default 30.

prefix.description: Only alarms whose name starts with this.

region.description: The AWS Region, for example us-east-1. It may be left out when Sidekick reads only one Region.

since.description: Only state changes at or after this time, in RFC 3339 form, for example 2026-05-04T10:00:00Z. Default: 24 hours before until.

state.description: Only alarms in this state. Default ALARM.

until.description: Only state changes before this time, in RFC 3339 form, for example 2026-05-04T10:00:00Z. Default: now.

tools.name: list_changes
tools.description: List the write events of CloudTrail event history in a time range, newest first: which API was called on which resources, by whom, and whether it failed, with a console link to each event. Read-only calls are left out.

account.description: The 12-digit AWS account ID. It may be left out when Sidekick reads only one account.

eventSource.description: Only events of this AWS service, for example ecs.amazonaws.com.

limit.description: The most items to return, 1 to 200. Default 50.

region.description: The AWS Region, for example us-east-1. It may be left out when Sidekick reads only one Region.

resource.description: Only events about this resource, by name or ARN, for example checkout or arn:aws:ecs:us-east-1:111122223333:service/shop/checkout.

since.description: Only events at or after this time, in RFC 3339 form, for example 2026-05-04T10:00:00Z. Default: 24 hours before until.

until.description: Only events before this time, in RFC 3339 form, for example 2026-05-04T10:00:00Z. Default: now.

tools.name: get_eks_cluster
tools.description: Get an EKS cluster: status, Kubernetes and platform version, support type and health issues, and its managed node groups with their status, version, size and health issues. Without cluster, list the clusters.

account.description: The 12-digit AWS account ID. It may be left out when Sidekick reads only one account.

cluster.description: The cluster's name. Leave it out to list the clusters.

region.description: The AWS Region, for example us-east-1. It may be left out when Sidekick reads only one Region.

tools.name: get_ecs_service
tools.description: Get an ECS service: status, desired, running and pending tasks, its deployments with their rollout state, and its latest service events, newest first. Without service, list the cluster's services.

account.description: The 12-digit AWS account ID. It may be left out when Sidekick reads only one account.

limit.description: The most items to return, 1 to 100. Default 20.

region.description: The AWS Region, for example us-east-1. It may be left out when Sidekick reads only one Region.

service.description: The service's name. Leave it out to list the cluster's services.

tools.name: list_health_events
tools.description: List the AWS Health events of the account in the Region and for global services, updated in a time range, newest first: service, type, status, times and the latest description. Needs a Business, Enterprise On-Ramp or Enterprise support plan.

account.description: The 12-digit AWS account ID. It may be left out when Sidekick reads only one account.

limit.description: The most items to return, 1 to 100. Default 20.

region.description: The AWS Region, for example us-east-1. It may be left out when Sidekick reads only one Region.

since.description: Only events updated at or after this time, in RFC 3339 form, for example 2026-05-04T10:00:00Z. Default: 24 hours before until.

status.description: Only events with this status. Default any.

until.description: Only events updated before this time, in RFC 3339 form, for example 2026-05-04T10:00:00Z. Default: now.
